en.autoPriceHint: fill untagged models from the built-in rules
en.bgHint: the theme's menu colour is translucent, so the conversation shows through; opaque is the most readable, theme adds a backdrop blur
en.bgSolidHint: compute an opaque colour from the theme base — most readable
en.bgThemeHint: keep the translucent menu colour and blur what is behind it
en.cheapHint: daily: preferred by default, saves money
en.classifierHint: detection: keywords = the match list in your presets; semantic = one small model call per turn
en.confirmAttn: new conversation needs a routing plan
en.confirmHint: asked once per conversation; changing scope / model / task / pool asks again
en.confirmInherited: carried over from your last choice
en.confirmNew: new conversation — confirm this routing plan
en.costHint: your own relative price: the dearer it is, the harder the step must be to pick it (1/4/8 deduct 0.4 / 1.6 / 3.2)
en.crossHint: changing brand is weightier than swapping models inside one: it asks first by default; “once” lets just this step through
en.crossSettingHint: whether the router may move this chat to another brand: allow = yes, ask = confirm first, off = stay on the current brand
en.effortHint: only the thinking level of the one model you pick below — out until you do
en.effortModelHint: pick exactly one model below — the router only adjusts its thinking level and stays out until you do
en.effortModelTitle: Effort mode works on one model
en.engagedHint: green dot = the router is controlling: it changes the model / effort as needed; click to adjust
en.fullHint: let the router change both model and effort
en.groupAddHint: add every model of this provider to the pool
en.groupRemoveHint: remove this provider's models from the pool
en.imagesHint: image steps: leave alone = normal rules; vision model = force a vision-tagged model
en.name: Name
en.netPriceHint: pull an OpenRouter price snapshot, then price the pool
en.noSession: no session yet — your pick becomes the default and applies once this conversation starts
en.officialEmptyEfforts: This model provides no reasoning effort levels
en.poolHint2: tick the models the router may use — only ticked ones are selectable; effort mode picks exactly one
en.pressureHint: context pressure: prefer the cheap model when the window is nearly full
en.scopeHint: what the router may change: Model+Effort = model + effort; Effort = only the thinking level of the one model you pick; Model = model only
en.strongHint: heavy: preferred once a step turns hard or evidence of trouble appears
en.taskHint: auto = your keyword rules decide; or force one type
en.tierHint: daily = use it all the time; heavy = prefer it for hard/engineering steps (hard +15, engineering +8)
en.title: Model router
en.yieldedHint: amber dot = stood down: you picked a model by hand, so the router holds back; click to resume
